name: Pic Smaller
description: Privacy-first batch image compressor powered by ImageQuant (pngquant engine) and OxiPNG alongside MozJPEG, WebP, AVIF, SVG, GIF, and HEIC codecs running locally in your browser with interactive before-and-after comparison, resizing, cropping, and ZIP export.
short_desc: Batch image optimizer with ImageQuant + OxiPNG, MozJPEG, AVIF, WebP, and ZIP export
author: joye61

form_fields.label: container_name
form_fields.hint: Custom Docker container name. Default: pic-smaller (if left blank, falls back to pic-smaller).
form_fields.pattern_error: Must start with a letter or number and contain at least 2 characters (letters, numbers, '.', '_' or '-').
